cat.title: Worcester State University Undergraduate Catalog - International Applicants

test_policy.notes: Test-optional: SAT/ACT are not required and international applicants may opt in to the test-optional policy; the catalog recommends submitting a personal essay to support the application. CDS C8: not required for admission, but considered if submitted.

requirements.notes: Common App or the Worcester State Application. International documents: official secondary transcript or national exam results with a professional credential evaluation, English test if applicable, original bank letter or notarized financial affidavit (currently at least $34,900 for one year, subject to change) and a passport copy; minimum 2.0 cumulative GPA, and meeting minimums does not guarantee admission. Nursing (BSN) and Occupational Studies are selective majors with firm deadlines.

deadlines.label: Early Action (first-year, fall 2027 entry)
deadlines.notes: Listed as 'Early Action (First-Years Only)' in the deadlines table; the page does not say whether international applicants can use it. The page prints no year, so it is taken as the current cycle.

deadlines.label: Nursing (BSN) and Occupational Studies fall deadline
deadlines.notes: The catalog gives January 15 for Fall-only Nursing (BSN) and Occupational Studies applicants instead of April 1; no year printed, taken as fall 2027.

deadlines.label: Regular Decision priority date (domestic first-year, fall)
deadlines.notes: Domestic first-year priority date in the deadlines table; international students use the April 1 date below. CDS C13 lists rolling admission starting Nov 1 and a May 1 application closing date.

deadlines.label: International students: fall priority deadline
deadlines.notes: Deadlines table: 'International Students - Fall entrance priority deadline April 1'; the catalog says all documents must be submitted before April 1 for fall. Spring (Nov 15) is open to international applicants only in limited cases listed in the catalog. No year printed, taken as fall 2027.

deadlines.label: Admissions deposit (needed before an I-20 is issued)
deadlines.notes: Catalog: Worcester State will not issue a Form I-20 until the admissions deposit is paid; the fall deposit deadline is May 1 with no exceptions.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Required for applicants whose native language is not English or who studied in a country where English is not the native language. Applicants with an Associate of Arts or Science degree from a regionally accredited U.S. college are not required to submit a test.

english.notes: Minimum for exams taken before Jan 21, 2026 (international applicants page and catalog agree).
Minimum for exams taken after Jan 21, 2026; the page prints '4' without naming the scale.
The International Applicants page says 6.5; the catalog table says 6.0 for the same test. The stricter 6.5 is recorded; confirm with admissions.
Undergraduate minimum on both the page and the catalog.

aid.notes: International students are automatically considered for a merit scholarship of up to $18,000 USD ($2,250 per semester for up to eight semesters); renewal needs a 2.5 GPA, full-time enrollment and out-of-state classification. The page says there are no need-based scholarships or financial aid for international students. CDS H lists 44 nonresident undergraduates with institutional aid (average $4,168); the CDS text still says $15,000, so the newer website figure is used.

majors.notes: Selective major with rigorous criteria and a firm January 15 deadline; meeting the minimums does not guarantee admission, and current students cannot change their major to Nursing (BSN Track I).

toefl.note: The page gives Worcester State code 3524 for the English test score reports (TOEFL, IELTS, PTE, DAAD, EIKEN, Duolingo, iTEP).
